review_evidence: README identifies the source as MIT category-theory class notes.
Main.lean develops functor/contrafunctor and natural-transformation machinery and proves Yoneda/coyoneda lemmas, composition associativity and monadic equivalences.
Although pedagogical and concentrated in one primary file, the formal definitions and theorem statements are independently searchable category-theory prior art.
summary: Reviewed category-theory-notes; retain its self-contained category-theoretic teaching formalization.
